soviet-union.label: Soviet Union
soviet-union.fact: The flag of a country covering 1/6 of the world's land. Gagarin flew to space under it - and under it the country vanished from the map.

yugoslavia.label: Yugoslavia (SFRY)
yugoslavia.fact: Six republics, one flag with a red star - and a decade of wars after the breakup.

gdr.label: East Germany
gdr.fact: It differed from the West German flag only by the hammer and compass in the centre. The country vanished in 1990.

czechoslovakia.label: Czechoslovakia
czechoslovakia.fact: The flag with the blue wedge outlived the country: in 1993 Czechia kept it, and Slovakia didn't object.

ottoman.label: Ottoman Empire
ottoman.fact: The crescent and star are 80 years older than Turkey - the republic simply inherited the empire's flag.

austria-hungary.label: Austria-Hungary
austria-hungary.fact: An empire of a dozen peoples and two halves. It collapsed in 1918, failing to survive World War I.

persia.label: Persia
persia.fact: The lion and sun symbolised Persia for centuries. In 1979 the revolution removed the lion from the flag for good.

south-vietnam.label: South Vietnam
south-vietnam.fact: The yellow flag with three red stripes lived 27 years. After the fall of Saigon it survived only in the diaspora.

tibet.label: Tibet
tibet.fact: Snow lions - a flag banned in the PRC. That is exactly why it became a worldwide symbol.

zanzibar.label: Sultanate of Zanzibar
zanzibar.fact: An Arab sultanate off the coast of Africa that lived on cloves and the slave trade. It ended with the 1964 revolution.

sikkim.label: Sikkim
sikkim.fact: A Himalayan kingdom between India and China. In 1975 India absorbed it - by referendum.

zaire.label: Zaire
zaire.fact: Mobutu's name for Congo - after a garbled Portuguese word for «river». The name was reverted in 1997.

uar.label: United Arab Republic
uar.fact: Egypt and Syria as one country. Syria left after 3 years, but Egypt kept this flag for 11 more.

serbia-montenegro.label: Serbia and Montenegro
serbia-montenegro.fact: Yugoslavia's last name. A tricolour without a star - and without a future: it split peacefully in 2006.

rhodesia.label: Rhodesia
rhodesia.fact: A country almost the whole world refused to recognise. A flag with a shield - and fifteen years of war.

hawaii-kingdom.label: Kingdom of Hawaii
hawaii-kingdom.fact: The only US state flag with the British Union Jack - Hawaii kept the flag of its kingdom.

newfoundland.label: Dominion of Newfoundland
newfoundland.fact: A separate country that in 1949 voted itself into becoming just a province of Canada.

west-indies.label: West Indies Federation
west-indies.fact: A union of Britain's Caribbean colonies. It lasted four years - and broke up into ten countries.

cae.label: Central African Empire
cae.fact: Bokassa crowned himself emperor for 20 million dollars. He didn't bother changing the flag.

transvaal.label: Transvaal
transvaal.fact: A British colony on the site of the Boer South African Republic - the one whose gold started the war.

texas.label: Republic of Texas
texas.fact: The 1839 «Lone Star» lives on - the republic's flag became the state flag.

taiping.label: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
taiping.fact: A peasant «Christian kingdom» inside China. The war over it claimed more lives than World War I.

black-flag-army.label: Black Flag Army
black-flag-army.fact: Liu Yongfu's Chinese militia that fought the French in Vietnam. Its flag was the direct opposite of the «Yellow Flags».

sulu.label: Sultanate of Sulu
sulu.fact: A maritime sultanate between the Philippines and Malaysia. Its heirs are still suing over the province of Sabah.

granada.label: Emirate of Granada
granada.fact: The last Islamic state on Spanish soil. It fell the year Columbus set out across the ocean.

british-eic.label: British East India Company
british-eic.fact: A company with its own flag, army and right to wage war. It ruled India until London took it all for itself.

voc.label: Dutch East India Company
voc.fact: The first multinational corporation in history - with a monopoly, a fleet and wars of its own.

gadsden.label: Gadsden flag
gadsden.fact: «Don't tread on me» - a US War of Independence flag that 250 years later became a political meme.

green-mountain.label: Green Mountain Boys
green-mountain.fact: Vermont militia that fought for independence from Britain. Their flag became the flag of the Vermont Republic.

jolly-roger.label: Jolly Roger
jolly-roger.fact: The black flag was raised to avoid a fight: surrender without resistance - and maybe you'll live.

amsterdam.label: Amsterdam
amsterdam.fact: Three St Andrew's crosses. Amsterdammers joke they stand for blood, fire and plague - everything the city survived.

tokyo.label: Tokyo
tokyo.fact: A six-rayed sun - the flag of Japan's capital, not the country. The country's is white with a red circle.

prague.label: Prague
prague.fact: A red-and-white diagonal - one of Europe's oldest city flags, known since the 13th century.

st-petersburg.label: Saint Petersburg
st-petersburg.fact: Two crossed anchors - river and sea - with a sceptre: a port city of two elements, built by an empire.

rio.label: Rio de Janeiro
rio.fact: A white flag with a blue circle - a legacy of the Portuguese crown: the monarchy's coat of arms used to be here.

venice.label: Republic of Venice
venice.fact: «The Most Serene» lasted 1,100 years - longer than almost any state in history. Napoleon ended it.

genoa.label: Republic of Genoa
genoa.fact: The cross of St George. The Genoese are sure England borrowed its flag from them.

byzantium.label: Byzantine Empire
byzantium.fact: Four fire-steels in the corners - the labarum of the Palaiologos dynasty, which ruled until the fall of Constantinople.

prussia.label: Prussia
prussia.fact: A black eagle on white. The state has been gone since 1947 - the Allies abolished it by formal decree.

korea-empire.label: Korean Empire
korea-empire.fact: The Taegukgi from when Korea declared itself an empire. 13 years later Japan annexed it.

qing.label: Qing dynasty
qing.fact: The yellow dragon - the first national flag in China's history. Before the Qing, China had no flag at all.

mughal.label: Mughal Empire
mughal.fact: The «alam» standard of the empire that ruled India for three hundred years - from Babur to the last padishah.

belgian-congo.label: Congo Free State
belgian-congo.fact: Not a colony but the personal property of Belgium's King Leopold II. The darkest project of the era.

british-india.label: British India
british-india.fact: The red ensign with the Star of India - the flag of the Raj under which Britain ruled the subcontinent.
